title: Spatial Navigation Memory of Object Locations
description: This dataset contains behavioral events and intracranial electrophysiological (iEEG) recordings from a spatial navigation memory task. Participants encoded object locations during guided navigation learning trials and then recalled the locations by navigating to them during test trials. Data were collected at multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania.
methods_description: Each session comprised 50 trials (2 practice, 48 experimental). Each trial had two learning trials, in which participants were driven to a visible object, followed by one test trial, in which they navigated from a random start location and orientation to the remembered location of the invisible object. Trials were counterbalanced using reflected object and start positions. iEEG was recorded with Blackrock or Medtronic systems and provided in both monopolar and bipolar montages, with MNI and Talairach coordinates when available.
